verdict.rationale: Sift's docs show a clear scoring model (0‑100), a Workflows rules‑automation platform for real‑time decisioning, and a Decisions API for custom actions (approve, block, ban, cancel) tied to score thresholds, which supports mapping score ranges to actions and tuning cutoffs per business (sift-docs-5, sift-docs-6, sift-docs-7, sift-docs-12, sift-docs-3). However, there is no explicit documentation of a built‑in 'step‑up 3DS' action or granular UI for setting multiple threshold bands (only generic block/approve/review language), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of threshold customization. Missing for 10: explicit step-up 3DS action support, detailed UI/config walkthrough for multiple score-range-to-action mappings, and third-party validation of threshold tuning.
